industry.drivers: GST cut on 2Ws (Sep-2025) lifted volumes from Q3FY26; draft rule (Jun-2025) to extend ABS to smaller bikes, not yet final; premiumisation (inverted forks, ABS, alloy wheels, disc brakes on 125cc+); electric 2W/3W (Endurance's products except clutches are EV-agnostic); 4W aluminium castings for China+1 sourcing; state incentives (Maharashtra PSI).
industry.headwinds: West Asia conflict: aluminium, steel, gas and fuel prices up (RMC 68.4% of standalone income in Q1FY27); Europe: energy at ~3x 2021 levels, Chinese OEMs taking share with imported powertrains, OEM restructuring (VW, Mercedes); GST-boosted base from Q3FY27.

excluded.BHARATFORG: Earnings distorted: a Rs358 cr exceptional charge turned the Jun-2026 quarter into a loss, so its ~93x trailing P/E on 30-Sep-2026 sits on depressed TTM EPS (as in the Uno Minda, Motherson and Bosch initiations).
excluded.GABRIEL: No five-year history: Screener's P/E series starts in May-2024 (after Gabriel's restructuring).

peers.notes: The auto-component peer set of the Uno Minda, Samvardhana Motherson and Bosch initiations (same as-of date) with Endurance itself replaced by Uno Minda. Tyre and battery makers are left out. SCHAEFFLER (December year-end) has P/E history only from Feb-2023, MSUMI from Apr-2022, ZFCVINDIA from May-2022: their medians cover the history available. Closest business peers: Uno Minda (2W/4W components), Bharat Forge (castings/forgings), Sona BLW, Gabriel (2W suspension; excluded).

brokers.thesis: Order backlog lets Endurance outgrow industry in India and Europe; 19%/21%/23% revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR FY26-28E; margin expansion from Q2FY27. Q1 PAT missed on Europe depreciation. FY28E EPS +35% (Europe depreciation normalises, margin 13.9%).
Broad-based growth (brakes, castings, battery packs, alloy wheels, suspension); margin recovery as commodity costs pass through; FY28E EPS raised 6.5%.
Target cut to Rs3,000 after Q4FY26 (aggregator record; note not read).
Order visibility, EV traction and new capacity support medium-term growth (post-Q4FY26 result update; target since met).

street.notes: Only two post-Q1FY27 notes with full estimates could be read (MOSL, Choice). Other brokers that cover the stock (ICICI Securities, Nuvama, Jefferies, Investec, Citi, Axis Capital hosted the Q1 call) had no dated post-Q1 note in public sources; Trendlyne's consensus page refused automated access (HTTP 429) and was not used. StockAnalysis showed an S&P Global consensus of Rs2,895-2,920 (14-16 analysts), last updated Feb-2026.

critiques: Order backlog lets Endurance outgrow industry in India and Europe; margins expand from Q2FY27.
Broad-based growth and margin recovery justify 30x FY28E.
Europe's order book is shrinking as Chinese OEMs import powertrains; growth ex-Stöferle was 2% in FY26.

gaps: Divisional (product) revenue is disclosed only as percentage shares of total income; no product profitability. Our segment model uses entities (India standalone, Maxwell, Europe).
Entity other income is not disclosed separately; entity EBITDA includes it, so we deduct consolidated other income as one line.

Only two post-Q1FY27 broker notes (MOSL, Choice) could be read in full; Geojit (Jun-2026) and Axis (May-2026) targets come from aggregator listings without the method. Trendlyne refused automated access (HTTP 429).
Named shareholders above 1% for Jun-2026 are not available in our sources (company SHP for Jun-2026 not found); we use Mar-2026 category data from the AR plus Jun-2026 category totals.
MD remuneration in rupees is not stated in the pages read; we show the ratio to the median employee.
Battery-pack margins are not disclosed ('will be clearer in the next call').
Mercedes hybrid programme value (~EUR40 mn a year) is from MOSL; the company did not state it.

Endurance's own trailing P/E median uses Screener's chart; Screener restates no Endurance quarter after 30-Sep-2026 for the period we use (Q1FY27 revenue Rs4,315 cr and PAT Rs245 cr match the filing).
conflicts: EBITDA margin: company 13.1% for Q1FY27 (incl. other income, on total income) vs 12.4% (ex other income, on revenue; MOSL, Choice, Screener). We show the company basis by entity and the Screener basis for the group.
Q1FY27 standalone margin: company 11.2% (incl. other income) vs MOSL 10.9% (ex other income).
FY26 Europe total income: Rs4,012 cr (Q4FY26 deck) vs Rs4,017 cr (Q1FY27 deck, Q1FY26 restated). We use Rs4,017 cr.
Q1FY27 orders won in India: Rs405 cr (deck, incl. Maxwell Rs13 cr) vs Rs391.6 cr (call, excl. Maxwell).
